description:
The Ultimate All-Rounder

The Gran Corsa represents the pinnacle of modern carbon road bike design. As Masi’s lightest all-round road bike, it’s built for riders who demand versatility without compromising on performance. Designed to excel across a variety of terrains, the Gran Corsa is equally at home on steep mountain climbs, sweeping descents, and endless flat roads.

Crafted from MASI lightweight carbon with internal cable routing, this speed machine offers sleek aerodynamics and unparalleled stiffness for efficient power transfer. The T47 threaded bottom bracket ensures robust reliability, making maintenance a breeze. Whether chasing personal bests, leading a group ride, or simply enjoying the road ahead, the Gran Corsa delivers an exhilarating and responsive ride.

The name Gran Corsa is a tribute to the spirit of grand races and epic rides. Masi’s heritage in performance cycling is reflected in every curve of its frame. From the starting line to the summit, the Gran Corsa responds with precision and confidence. The carefully tuned geometry offers a balanced riding position that optimizes both comfort and speed, allowing riders to go further, faster.

For cyclists who seek a bike that can do it all, the Gran Corsa is the perfect partner. It invites you to explore new routes, tackle ambitious goals, and experience the thrill of riding without limits. Ride with power, ride with grace — this is Gran Corsa.
